GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. made some ground # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the 100m had to be restrained when crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 7l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the gelding hung in under pressure in the home straight and did not stretch out comfortably. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4-5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, battled on strong to the line, just no match late # even effort
Jumped Ok sat 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled back. Failed to muster speed in the early stages. Approaching the 1300m was eased off heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted
j/o eased back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, running on half off 200m, run ended 150m and kept on one pace # had chance
Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, improved 3-4 Wide turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, running on 1 length off passing 200m, same 100m, kept finding the line, got the bob # had run/just!!

Jumped Ok eased 3 Wide Mid Field No Cover 3-4l. had good run to Turn . peeled wider into Straight , Quickly let down and Ran On Strongly . lost its way 200m when joined ldr. Battled On Well in 2 Horse War but held narrowly to line. vet = dislodged rider prior, passed fit # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after dislodging its rdr en route to the barriers and cantered riderless for a short distance, and was passed suitable to race. Bumped on jumping. Near the 1100m had to be steadied to avoid heels. Shifted in under pressure over the final 150m resulting in its rdr having to stop riding and straighten.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away OK. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken @ 450m. Pressured Two Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Challenge leader @ 200m & did best in last 75m. # On-pace/too good.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to lay out when placed under pressure rounding the home turn. Near the 150m shifted in and brushed another rnr, requiring its rider to stop riding and straighten the gelding.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside in Straight 3 lengths. ran on well # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 900m had to be steadied off the heels of rnr which was taken out.
